description.zh: 连接后可使用跟进记录查询、拜访打卡查询、跟进记录搬运录入等全部磐石业务接口（客户/商机定位、角色鉴权、打卡关联、写入）。一次授权，本专家全部 skill 通用。
description.en: Once connected, all Panshi business APIs used by this expert are available: follow-up query, visit check-in query, and follow-up record migration/write-in (customer/opportunity locating, role auth, check-in linking). One auth, all skills.

helpDescription.zh: 前往 PAT 申请页面，授权应用选「omp_service_woa_prod」（中文名：磐石），创建后把令牌粘贴到上方输入框。
helpDescription.en: Visit the PAT application page, select 'omp_service_woa_prod' (Chinese name: 磐石/Panshi) as the authorized app, then paste the token into the input field above.

note.zh: crm-visit-sync 的分支 A（文档类搬运）在读取文档链接时依赖以下 WorkBuddy 内置连接器，请在「连接器管理」中按需授权后使用；这些为平台内置连接器，无需在本文件里填写 URL/Token。
note.en: The document-branch (branch A) of crm-visit-sync relies on the following WorkBuddy built-in connectors to read source links. Authorize them in the connector manager as needed. They are built-in connectors and do NOT require URL/Token entries here.
